description: This file contains the implementation of the 'git update-ref' command in C, including parsing command-line arguments, handling various update scenarios for Git references, and managing reference transactions with support for batch operations.

methods.name: const char * parse_arg(const char * next,struct strbuf * arg)

methods.name: void parse_cmd_symref_delete(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)

methods.name: void report_ok(const char * command)
methods.description: Reports successful execution of a command.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_option(struct ref_transaction * transaction UNUSED,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses command options, currently handling the 'no-deref' option.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_start(struct ref_transaction * transaction UNUSED,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the start command, indicating the beginning of a transaction.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_prepare(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Prepares a transaction for commit.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_abort(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing transaction.

methods.description: Commits the transaction, applying all changes.
